meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, members discussed the works to be carried out by the committee. First, Dhiggaru Constituency Member Ahmed Nazim proposed to clarify the details of the ongoing projects undertaken by Housing Development Corporation and Fahi Dhiriulhun Corporation, the time frame for which they are scheduled to be completed, and the difficulties faced by them in completing the projects and to clarify the details about the merger of the two companies from Ministry of Finance. It was seconded by Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali. Below are the vote details of the proposal. Vote: To clarify the details of the ongoing projects undertaken by Housing Development Corporation and Fahi Dhiriulhun Corporation and to clarify the details about the merger of the two companies from the Ministry of Finance. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 03 Voted Yes: 02 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, this proposal was unanimously passed by the Committee.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled.Senior Officer Shifna Ali presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali proposed to elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir. Below are the vote details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 03 Voted Yes: 03 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed was elected as the Chair of the Committee. Then, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed to elect Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali as the Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 03 Voted Yes: 03 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. For a last thing, Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To decide the committe quorum as 3 members. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 03 Voted Yes: 02 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, the committee quorum was decided to be 3 members. It was also decided to review the reports prepared by the Privatization and Corporatization Board on companies in the committee's domain.
